name: ponpon2
desc: pixel art RPG game sprite, three-quarter top-down view from the front right: a cute custom hot rod folk toy car with no cabin, no roof and no seats: a low wide rounded dome-shaped tin body painted cream with red pinstripes and chrome trim, a huge chrome V8 engine sunk into the middle of the body with a silver GMC supercharger blower on top and a black air scoop whose mouth faces forward, four short chrome exhaust pipes on each side pointing up and out, a face on the front: two round headlight eyes and one big round red bumper nose, fat black treaded tires, a black cable coming out of the right side of the engine

refs.use: the car with a face on the left side of this sketch: copy its shape (low dome, engine, face). ignore the drum and the creature

name: drum
desc: pixel art RPG game sprite, three-quarter top-down view: an old rusty steel oil drum with two raised rings, standing on two red bricks, burning a small campfire of dry autumn leaves inside, orange flames and a little smoke

name: tori2
desc: pixel art RPG game sprite, three-quarter top-down view from the front right: a Japanese wooden pull toy. In front a mother duck: bottle-shaped glossy orange wooden body narrowing at the back, red chest, gold and black painted wing, round dark olive head with a red ringed eye, a short pink peg beak, standing on a thin wire fork with one small wooden disc wheel. Behind her, attached, a round orange wooden tub with a black rim on top, two big wooden wheels with black edges and painted rings on the sides, and inside the tub a small round turntable with two little ochre egg-shaped ducklings with pointed beaks and red cheeks sitting facing different directions

refs.use: the real toy: copy shapes and colors exactly

name: miton2
desc: pixel art RPG game character sprite, front view, standing: miton, a tall folk toy lady shaped like a simple straight cylinder with no neck (head and body the same width), cream body, a pink pig face with a big round pink snout with two nostrils, small pointed pig ears, tiny black eyes behind round glasses, a pearl necklace, elegant and calm

refs.use: the tall pig-faced character with glasses and pearl necklace
